nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The street is brighter than the corridor, and no warmer.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: You walked out of the school into a street in the late afternoon light.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The gate is behind you. Nobody stopped you, nobody walked you out.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The road goes on, turns once, and stops being a road you know.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The school from outside: tile up to the sill, bare concrete above. One window on the second floor is open. The room behind it is dark.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: There is a camera on a bracket, pointed at a strip of empty grass. It turns slowly, as if counting the grass.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: Outside the school there is a camera turning slowly over the grass.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You fix the position: the school on this side of the road, the three blocks across from it. A row of empty brick squares along the foot of the wall.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: A notice taped to a pole, printed in a font that has been photocopied too many times.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: It is about a lost cat. The photograph is not of the cat in the description.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: The lost-cat notice on the pole shows a different cat than the one it describes.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The date at the bottom is four years old. The tape is new.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You come round to the wall again. Tile, bare concrete, the open window on the second floor - all of it as it was.

nodes.speaker: voice_orientation
nodes.text: Wait. Not the wall - the patch of road the wall should be throwing its shadow across.

nodes.speaker: voice_orientation
nodes.text: This road runs east to west and the wall is on the south side. In the morning its shadow should reach the middle of the road. There is no shadow at all, and the wall is still there. It is the shadow that is gone, not the wall.

nodes.speaker: voice_orientation
nodes.text: ...I cannot say. This stretch of road is not the same width as the last one. I may be remembering it wrong.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You step back and look up again. The school is where it was, not one brick short. Only, in your memory it stood further left than this.
